verdict.rationale: Relay documents issuing up to 50 virtual or physical Visa debit cards, and lets you set spend limits and track transactions in real time. That covers creating virtual cards with basic controls. Nothing in the evidence shows cards locked to a specific vendor or merchant category such as ad spend, or that virtual cards are created instantly. missing for 10: purpose/vendor-scoped card controls (merchant or category locking), evidence of instant virtual card issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
